answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent economies, requiring participants to lock collateral within an island of staked assets. By anchoring identity to capital, the network forces an attacker to purchase a reef of tokens, rendering the cost of generating hollow identities economically prohibitive. This transition from computational effort to financial skin-in-the-game ensures that each agent represents a quantifiable liability, effectively neutralizing low-cost mass creation.
